<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/api/node/{hostname}/user/{name}/password"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Sets the password with chpasswd -e, from its hash on standard input. The controller hashes the password, so the job and NATS have only the hash. Each call makes a new hash, so it always reports changed: true. A user that the host does not have is not found. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped.
